messages.クイックと脆弱・次元の亀裂で場を整えつつ、充電を使った一度きりの復活を持つ傲慢斬: A Pride Slash E.G.O that sets up the field with Haste, Fragile, and Dimensional Rift, and has a one-time revival using Charge.
messages.充電とクイック: 攻撃前に充電回数が増え(解析Ⅲで3から5)、次のターンにクイッ: **Charge and Haste**: Increases Charge Count before attacking (from 3 to 5 at Threadspin Ⅲ) and grants 2 Haste next turn. Suited to combos where action order matters.
messages.脆弱と次元の亀裂: Ⅰコインの的中時に脆弱1と次元の亀裂(解析Ⅲで2から4)を付: **Fragile and Dimensional Rift**: Coin Ⅰ inflicts 1 Fragile and Dimensional Rift (from 2 to 4 at Threadspin Ⅲ) on hit. Dimensional Rift turns into Rupture Count and disappears at Turn End.
messages.パッシブ「もつれた現状復旧」: マイナス効果を持つ敵への的中で充電回数が1増える: **Passive — Entangled Phenomena Restoration**: Hitting an enemy with a negative effect increases Charge Count by 1, up to 4 per turn. When his HP would reach 0, he spends all Charge and recovers HP based on the amount (once per battle, up to 25% of HP).
messages.侵蝕スキル: 敵味方識別不可で現体力が最も高い対象を攻撃し、敵味方識別不可で現体: **Corrosion skill**: Cannot distinguish friend from foe, attacks the target with the highest current HP, and spends 10 Charge to increase the Fragile and Dimensional Rift inflicted. It assumes Charge is secured.
messages.充電を扱う人格と組み合わせ、充電を貯めた状態で撃つ。復活の回復量は充電の量次第。: Combine it with Identities that use Charge and fire it with Charge built up. The revival's healing depends on the amount of Charge.
messages.覚醒スキルは一般戦闘では最後方の対象を攻撃するので、狙いを決めたいときは注意する: In regular battles, the Awakening skill attacks the rearmost target, so be careful when you want to choose a target.
messages.Ⅲ: 基本威力が20から22、充電獲得と次元の亀裂が増え、侵蝕スキルも強化される: **Ⅲ**: Base Power goes from 20 to 22, Charge gain and Dimensional Rift increase, and the Corrosion skill is strengthened.
messages.Ⅳ: 攻撃加重値が3になり、広域になる。: **Ⅳ**: Attack Weight becomes 3, making it multi-target.
messages.R社第4群トナカイチーム: S1(暴食)が充電回数を増やし、充電を消費するスキル: **[R Corp. 4th Pack Reindeer](persona:0612)**: S1 (Gluttony) increases Charge Count, and he has a full set of Charge-spending skills, helping with Charge management.
messages.K社3級摘出職職員: S1(傲慢)とS2(暴食)で必要資源を出せ、S2・S3で破: **[K Corp. Class 3 Excision Staff](persona:0605)**: S1 (Pride) and S2 (Gluttony) supply the required affinities, and S2 and S3 inflict Rupture, meshing with Dimensional Rift's conversion into Rupture Count.
